A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–N. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on Sciplex, Marson, Morpho-MNIST, and CelebA-HQ, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, and generated examples.

after.justification: v3 retains original experimental results in Section 3 and Appendix N, including benchmark comparisons, marginal-estimator evaluations, and disentanglement analyses.

M1.justification: The VCI objective, counterfactual supervision, latent-divergence regularization, robust marginal estimator, and model architectures are unchanged. Revised notation and explanations do not alter the procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four datasets and intervention scenarios. Digit-intervention examples already appear in v2 Figure 13; the additional references to them in v3 introduce no new coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 1 retains AE, CEVAE, GANITE, and CPA; Table 2 retains DEAR, Diff-SCM, CHVAE, MED, and SAE. The ablation variants and Appendix N comparison methods are also retained.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, model configurations, training schedules, intervention sampling, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged in Appendix M. Replacing 'MSE' with 'error' in some prose and captions does not change the metrics shown in tables and plots.

E4.justification: Section 3.2 extends the ablation account with a qualitative report that counterfactual supervision also improves early optimization on single-cell datasets. No corresponding new curves or detailed analysis are supplied; Figures 3 and 10 and the Appendix N analyses are otherwise unchanged.

E5.justification: The existing five-independent-run reporting, standard errors, and variability plots are retained. No run counts, uncertainty-reporting practices, or statistical procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: v3 newly reports that the early-training benefit of counterfactual supervision also occurs on single-cell datasets when measured by mean R2. Numerical tables and plotted or sampled outcomes are unchanged; for example, Table 2 retains VCI's mixed-intervention image MSE of 0.36 × 10^-2.

T1.justification: The assumptions, definitions, mathematical results, and proofs retain their substance. Appendix D turns existing inline formulas into Equations 11–13, expectation notation is standardized, and Corollary 3's erroneous reference to Theorem 3 is corrected to Theorem 2.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a counterfactual variational formulation, supervision without observed counterfactuals, latent disentanglement, robust marginal estimation, and empirical advantages.

C2.justification: The explanations of training stability, metric limitations, fairness, unobserved confounding, and relations among treatments remain substantively unchanged. The added causal-hierarchy labels and main-text remarks about surrogate metrics restate distinctions already present in v2.

D1.justification: Appendices J–M retain the same architecture, embeddings, gradient-detaching options, hyperparameters, preprocessing, and hardware information. The code-access information and link target are unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list, related-work comparison, and substantive positioning remain unchanged. The Melistas citation moves from Appendix N.4 to Section 3.2, while the added Pearl citation accompanies an existing interventional-versus-counterfactual distinction.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording and paragraph edits, adds a 'Semi-autoencoding' signpost, supplies explicit pointers to assumptions and Figure 13, and corrects a theorem cross-reference. The overall narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 3 moves from above Appendix A into the related-work section and is reformatted. Existing Appendix D formulas become numbered displays, several captions are revised, and surrounding material reflows. All figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves readability and navigation through clearer assumption references, correction of Corollary 3's theorem reference, better placement of Table 3, and more readable displayed formulas. The scientific content and quantitative evidence remain essentially stable. The new single-cell training observation lacks additional numerical support, so it provides only a limited evidential gain.
